# Moraine Township

> Moraine Township is a special purpose unit of local government in southeast Lake County,
> Illinois, established in 1850. It serves 33,946 residents across Highwood, Fort Sheridan, most
> of Highland Park, and parts of Lake Forest and Deerfield, from an office at
> 800 Central Avenue, Highland Park, Illinois 60035.

Main phone: 847-432-3240. Email: info@morainetownship.org.
Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Central.
The entire website is published in English, Spanish, and Russian.

## What the Township can help a resident with

- **Food Pantry**: free groceries for income-qualified Township residents. Open Monday
  2:00 to 4:00 p.m., Tuesday 10:00 a.m. to noon, and Wednesday 1:30 to 3:30 p.m. Applications
  are available in English, Spanish, and Russian. Once a month every shopper also receives
  household goods and personal care products. Contact 847-432-3240 or
  coordinator@morainetownship.org.
- **General and Emergency Assistance**: state-regulated help toward monthly basic living
  expenses such as rent, utilities, and food for residents who qualify. Emergency Assistance
  covers life-threatening circumstances and job-related expenses, and it is flexible: residents
  whose situation is not one of the examples should call anyway. Call 847-432-3240.
- **Door-to-door transportation**: paratransit for Township residents 65 and older and
  residents with disabilities. Weekdays 8:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., up to 15 miles from the rider's
  home, including the VA and the medical centers in Evanston and Libertyville. $4 each way, $2 for
  income-qualified riders, and caregivers ride free. Call 847-432-3000.
- **Utility assistance**: LIHEAP, Share the Warmth, ComEd Hardship, and a Township summer
  program for income-qualified seniors and disabled residents.
- **Free income tax preparation**: IRS VITA program, Saturdays in tax season, for taxpayers
  earning under $67,000. Township residency is not required.
- **Health insurance enrollment**: free certified counselors for the state marketplace, Get
  Covered Illinois, and for Medicare through SHIP. Township residency is not required.
- **Passports**: applications accepted by appointment, Monday to Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
- **Voter registration**: in person at the Township office with two forms of ID.
- **Property assessment**: the Assessor's office handles exemptions, assessment questions, and
  appeals. Call 847-432-2100.
- **Notary service and RTA discount cards**: free, available to all residents. The Township does
  not notarize real estate deeds.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.morainetownship.org/): township news and services overview
- [About Us](https://www.morainetownship.org/about): mission, history since 1850, boundaries,
  demographics, elected officials, staff, and ethics
- [Resident Services](https://www.morainetownship.org/services): every service, split into those
  open to all residents and those requiring income qualification
- [Food Pantry](https://www.morainetownship.org/food-pantry): eligibility, hours, applications,
  most needed items, Amazon wish list, and drop-off, including what the pantry cannot accept
- [Assessor](https://www.morainetownship.org/assessor): assessment services, exemptions, Lake
  County resources, and the appeals process
- [Transportation](https://www.morainetownship.org/transportation): door-to-door paratransit
- [Board and Meetings](https://www.morainetownship.org/board-meetings): meeting schedule, the
  next meeting's agenda, and approved minutes under the Illinois Open Meetings Act
- [Cemeteries](https://www.morainetownship.org/cemeteries): Mooney and Daggitt cemeteries
- [Programs](https://www.morainetownship.org/programs): grant program, Latino Advisory Committee,
  and Community Mental Health Board
- [Get Involved](https://www.morainetownship.org/get-involved): volunteering
- [Donate](https://www.morainetownship.org/donate): Moraine Township Charitable Fund, Inc.,
  an IRS 501(c)(3), EIN 26-4269258
- [FOIA and Transparency](https://www.morainetownship.org/foia): FOIA officer, request procedure,
  fees, budgets, audits, levies, and compensation disclosure
- [Contact](https://www.morainetownship.org/contact): phone numbers, staff directory, and message
  form
- [Accessibility](https://www.morainetownship.org/accessibility): WCAG 2.1 Level AA conformance

## Boundary note

Moraine Township boundaries do not follow municipal lines. In some neighborhoods the line runs
down the middle of a residential street, so one side is in Moraine Township and the other is in
West Deerfield Township. Eligibility for Township services depends on living inside Moraine
Township. Residents who are unsure should call 847-432-2100 to confirm their address.
